translation.name: Diosa' kiika; Génesis, Éxodo y El Nuevo Testamento

content: Yumaa tinbunu lala' aa-apa millalanu Dios ya' mitya pamu rukulanu tsandikaatu, pure' bijee pakaamuwaave, tsenmin naake vee vee keeware' pakaanu ju'ba tsa tsanguemuwaave.
Tsaaren challa entsa de-inu tinbutalaya ya' Na' mityaa lalanu pave. Juntsa ya' Na' mityaa ti bain dekive, tsenmin naa ti juu bain yanu tene detaa shuikenu tireve.

Yaa Dios naaju tsamantsaañuba juntsaa keewarave, tsenmin Dios ura naajuñuba yaa entsaave ti' keewara jumuve. Yaa ya' palaa pudeechi ti juutala bain naa naa-inuuñuba tsanguikaren tanave. Tsejtu bene lala' ujcha depitsale' dyatu, selusha Diosa' chuchudinu chunjuu urandyasha chudive.
Diosa' Naya anjeelanu kayu pulla bale juu tiyaive, yaa kayu Dioschin juntsaanuu kura' mitya.
Tsenmin ma anjeenu laapu' ne entsandibaindityuwaave:

content.text: tsenmala yaa inchi Na junu tsuve,

content: Tsenmin yachi balenguramu Nanu, selusha mamikandu
entsandive: Dioschi kumuinchi ya' anjeela bain yanu teedi' aawa dekuresa, tive.
Tsejtu anjeelanu laapu' patuya, Diosa' Kiikanu entsandive:

content.text: tsandityu'ba, yachi tiba taawasha kemulanuya ñi llu'kaya juuñuu tirekive,

content: Tsaaren ya' Nanu laapu' pamiya entsandive:

content.text: Dios, ñu rei ju' naa-uwanuba tsaa tsananu tsuve,
tsenmin ñu rei ju' mika deechu' kemuve.
Ñuya uraa tene kenu tyamu' mitya,
Tsa' mityaa iya, ñu' Dios, ñunu mi'ke' kayu;
tsangue' kayu ñuchi ura' kera chachillanuba
Ñu, Bale Ruku, uma ajke' peepunu uwanuren tu kemuwaave;
tsenmin ñuren kai'sha tiba jenamulanu bain dekemuve.
Kumuinchi juntsala jalleeba ju' de-uinbu' kan tsanguenu detsuve;
juntsalanu uinbu jalleeba dejuñu dyajpiityulin tsanguenu juve ñu;
juntsalanu jalleeba dejuñu vera mavete' panan tsanguenu tsuve.

content: Matyu naaju anjeelaba Dioschi tiba kiikenu eramu deeve, livee inuu chachillanu kivetes nemula.

footnotes.text: 1.6 selusha mamikandu tityumujchi, veelaa entsangue aseetanguemu deeve: tusha ya' Nanu erendu. Naa tsaañu bain, Hebreos 2.5nu lende.
